purpose: Check whether residual after diagnostic future AP substitution can be explained by the future other-CPU rate prediction error, using already exported4C0 context. Arithmetic only, no fit/candidate/selection.
timing: After AP-only attribution viewed; registered before this added calculation. Secondary posthoc.
all4_C0: Use the same future35..120 other CPU core seconds/wall second from preboundary matched_C0_CPU_context.csv. Substitute both recorded future AP and this CPU rate only in diagnostic arithmetic at unchanged learned coefficients.
interpretation: Perfect values of these two included covariates, not perfect knowledge of the device. Remaining residual may reflect intercept/transfer/missing activity/frequency/measurement; do not assign a specific hidden physical cause.
